subject: critical crash error: Error in leadNamespace: there is no package called 'geoaxe'

messages.author: caa03a925deba113
messages.subject: critical crash error: Error in leadNamespace: there is no package called 'geoaxe'
parts:
Dear Illustrious developers and community - 

We are leading a workshop in Vietnam and one of our participants who is running R 3.6.1 on a MacBook Air with the newest OS, and she keeps getting a critical error that crashes wallace in module 1 (query GBIF). Wallace goes grey and crashes and in R studio, the error reads:

Warning: Error in loadNamespace: there is no package called 'geoaxe'

but when we try to install geoaxe there is no such package...

messages.author: caa03a925deba113
messages.subject: Re: critical crash error: Error in leadNamespace: there is no package called 'geoaxe'
parts: FYI we fixed it by replacing the R library folder with someone else’s ... so it’s probably a one computer issue.
